approval.body: Thanks for the fixes. The review changes only affect explicit overrides and fallback paths, and CI passed on this head.

reuse_decision: Keep original valid two-seed historical default-path measurements with their actual date/main/candidate. Do not relabel them as measurements on the new baseline. Continue already-running final-head comparisons because a relevant baseline default changed; not rerunning because of data age or merely because approval arrived.
review_fix_scope: Reviewer explicitly confirms repairs affect explicit overrides/fallback paths; final-head correctness tests and CI are applicable to those repairs.

confirmed_relevant_base_change.source: Qwen3ASRPipelineConfig.freeze_api_gc_on_startup nowTrue; launcher propagates flag and performs gc.collect/gc.freeze after API server startup. Earlier defaultFalse. This path is used by benchmarkserve.
confirmed_relevant_base_change.implication: API startup/runtime GC behavior changed between historical and currently measured baselines, so incremental performance/cost applicability cannot be established from review-fix scope or CI alone.

additional_shared_change.source: generation_batch_policy derives unset prefill bucket ladders forFULL aswell asBREAKABLE. FA4 added tosupportedFULL backends.
additional_shared_change.limit: FA4 addition alone is not relevant to these FA3 measurements. Actual bucket-path impact remains conditional on resolved overrides; no inferred performance effect claimed.

merge_readiness: Approval obtained; current-base independent performance/cost/quality comparison still pending. Follow existing queue and verify mergeability/checks/full no-docs diff at merge time.
